from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, transpile, assemble, Aer, execute, BasicAer, Qubit, ClassicalRegister
from qiskit.algorithms import QAOA
from qiskit.optimization import QuadraticProgram, minimize
from scipy.sparse import coo_matrix
import numpy as np
import networkx as nx
import dimod
import neal

def create_graph(vertices, edges):
    G = nx.Graph()
    G.add_nodes_from(vertices)
    G.add_weighted_edges_from(edges)
    return G

def max_cut_cost(G, x):
    cost = 0
    for (u, v), w in G.edges(data=True):
        cost += w * x[u] * (1 - x[v])
    return cost

def qaoa(G, p, q):
    n_qubits = len(G.nodes())
    qc = QuantumCircuit(n_qubits, n_qubits)

    # Initialize all qubits in the |+⟩ state
    for i in range(n_qubits):
        qc.h(i)

    # Apply alternating layers of rotation gates
    for layer in range(p + q):
        for i in range(n_qubits - 1):
            qc.ry(np.pi / p, i)
            qc.cx(i, i + 1)
        qc.ry(-np.pi / p, n_qubits - 1)

    return qc

def run_qaoa(G, p, q, shots):
    cost_min, params_opt = QAOA(max_cut_cost, G, p, q).optimize(maximization=True, seed_derivatives=True, initial_guess=[0.5]*4, optimizer=neal.NealSampler(num_restarts=20))
    circuit = qaoa(G, p, q).bind_parameters(params_opt)
    result = execute(circuit, BasicAer.get_backend('qasm_simulator'), shots=shots).result()
    counts = result.get_counts(circuit)
    return counts[0], cost_min

def solve_supplychain_split():
    vertices = [0, 1, 2, 3]
    edges = [[0, 1, 6], [1, 2, 8], [2, 3, 5], [0, 2, 2]]
    G = create_graph(vertices, edges)

    # QAOA parameters
    p = 10
    q = 20
    shots = 1000

    # Run QAOA and get the solution
    count, cost_min = run_qaoa(G, p, q, shots)

    # Calculate the approximation ratio
    optimal_cost = max_cut(G)
    approximation_ratio = cost_min / optimal_cost

    # Calculate success probability
    success_probability = count / shots

    # Calculate circuit depth
    circuit = qaoa(G, p, q)
    circuit = transpile(circuit, target=BasicAer.get_backend('qasm_simulator'))
    circuit_depth = circuit.depth()

    # Calculate two-qubit gate count
    two_qubit_gate_count = circuit.count_2q_gates()

    # Calculate optimizer calls
    optimizer_calls = 1

    # Max-Cut solution without QAOA (for comparison)
    nx.set_num_threads(1)  # Ensure single-threaded execution
    G_max_cut = nx.max_flow_max_cardinality(G)
    cut_value = sum(G_max_cut['matching'])

    return {
        "approximation_ratio": approximation_ratio,
        "success_probability": success_probability,
        "circuit_depth": circuit_depth,
        "two_qubit_gate_count": two_qubit_gate_count,
        "shots": shots,
        "optimizer_calls": optimizer_calls,
        "cut_value": cut_value
    }

def max_cut(G):
    return nx.max_flow_max_cardinality(G)['max_flow']
